subject: Madden (2026 film)
title: Is Madden a true story? Nicolas Cage's John Madden movie, explained
answer: Yes. "Madden," streaming on Prime Video from Nov. 18, 2026, is a biopic inspired by the real life of John Madden, the Raiders' Super Bowl-winning coach who became a famous broadcaster and the namesake of the Madden NFL video game. Nicolas Cage plays Madden; David O. Russell directed.
body:
Amazon says the film follows Madden from his Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, through his rise as a broadcaster, to building the Madden NFL game. Christian Bale plays Raiders owner Al Davis, Kathryn Hahn plays Madden's wife, Virginia, Sienna Miller plays Davis' wife, Carol, and John Mulaney plays EA Sports founder Trip Hawkins. Shane Gillis also appears. Russell wrote the script after an earlier draft by Cambron Clark. The movie skipped theaters and premieres globally on Prime Video, included with a Prime membership.

The real John Madden coached the Raiders from 1969 to 1978, going 112-32-14 with 10 playoff appearances, and won Super Bowl XI after the 1976 season. He called NFL games from 1979 to 2008 for CBS, Fox, ABC and NBC. The video game series began in 1988 as "John Madden Football." He was inducted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame in 2006 and died on Dec. 28, 2021, at 85.
in_the_news: "Madden" premieres on Prime Video on Nov. 18, 2026, in the middle of the NFL season.
